title: The United States declares war on Germany
summary: The US Congress voted to declare war on Germany at President Woodrow Wilson's request, bringing the United States into World War I.
reason: Germany had resumed unrestricted submarine warfare and the Zimmermann Telegram revealed a plot to ally with Mexico.
significance: American troops and resources tipped the balance toward the Allies and made the US a world power.
place: United States Capitol, Washington, D.C., United States
wikipedia: American entry into World War I
